versions.changelog:
ofox-video-core 2.0.3

- Updated version metadata to 2.0.3 in SKILL.md and associated files.
- Improved and updated documentation in SKILL.md, api-params.md, pricing.md, models-snapshot.json, and related reference files.
- Removed the deprecated skill-card.md file.
- Refined references and command examples to match current implementation and usage patterns.
- No changes to core API logic; updates focus on documentation clarity, pricing snapshots, and maintenance.

ofox-video-core 2.0.0

- Major version update with wide-ranging changes across core script and documentation.
- Significant updates to test coverage, including the addition of new test cases and refinement/removal of others.
- Substantial improvements and updates to API parameter references, approval gates, and provider/model documentation for clarity and accuracy.
- SKILL.md revised for newer practices and precision; versioning and metadata updated.
- Obsolete or redundant files removed to streamline the skill package.

ofox-video-core 1.30.0

- Adds robust host safety checks: API key is now only sent to OFOX's real host, and any override via OFOX_API_BASE_URL is announced with a clear NOTE on stderr.
- Polling for job completion only follows URLs matching the original host/scheme/port to prevent credential leaks; jobs with unexpected polling URLs must be collected manually using the job id.
- OFOX_API_BASE_URL must now use https:// (except for local dev), reinforcing security for all API calls.
- Documentation clarified and extended regarding model/mode matrix, real-world API parameters, and multi-shot/chain job behavior.
- New test script added (references/test/keyguard.test.sh); obsolete file skill-card.md removed.

ofox-video-core 1.27.1

- Version bump to 1.27.1 in SKILL.md and metadata.
- Updated documentation in SKILL.md, CHANGELOG.md, and references/prompt-structure.md.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.
- No functional changes to the skill's code or API behavior.

ofox-video-core v1.27.0

- Version bump to 1.27.0 in all metadata and documentation.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.
- Documentation updates: refreshed references and clarified instructions in CHANGELOG.md, SKILL.md, and supporting reference files.
- No functional or API changes to the skill logic.

ofox-video-core 1.26.0

- Added validation for `chain --shots-file` to refuse files where any line starts with an ALL-CAPS label (e.g., `SCENE:`, `STYLE:`), to prevent accidental multi-job billing from multi-line prompts.
- Blocked shots files containing lines with a leading `[A-Z ]+:` pattern, naming the offending line before any estimation or submission occurs.
- Updated documentation in SKILL.md to warn users about correct shots file usage and the new validation behavior.
- Added new test script (`references/test/localtools.test.sh`) for local tools.
- Removed obsolete `skill-card.md`.

ofox-video-core 1.24.0

- Adds detailed per-model pricing: `models` now prints each model's base rate at its default resolution, and `providers MODEL` outputs the full per-resolution, per-provider rate matrix for accurate quoting.
- Documentation (SKILL.md) improved: guidance on quoting based on up-to-date model pricing, highlighting parameter limits per model, and warning about quoting inaccuracies.
- Clarifies that model limits and cost spreads are model-specific (not family-based)—consult live data rather than relying on family generalizations.
- Removed deprecated/unused file: skill-card.md.
- General documentation and reference updates.

ofox-video-core 1.22.0

- Improved adaptive aspect ratio handling in image-to-video chains: now honors `adaptive` only where required/supported per model.
- Updated documentation to clarify adaptive aspect ratio rules and behavior for non-Seedance 2.5 models.
- Added automated test for adaptive aspect ratio branching.
- Refreshed model and pricing snapshots.
- Removed obsolete `skill-card.md` file.

ofox-video-core 1.21.3

- Updated documentation across multiple reference files for clarity and accuracy.
- Incremented version to 1.21.3 in SKILL.md and metadata.
- Removed the obsolete skill-card.md file.
- No code changes; all updates are to documentation and metadata only.

- Updated version to 1.21.2 in SKILL.md metadata and info.
- Removed unused file: skill-card.md.
- Documentation maintenance: minor edits to SKILL.md (version bump, metadata alignment).
- No changes to functionality or runtime behavior.

ofox-video-core 1.21.1

- Bumped version to 1.21.1.
- Updated references and documentation to reflect new version.
- Removed redundant skill-card.md file.
- No functional or API changes; maintenance and metadata updates only.

- Improved documentation and detail in SKILL.md, including usage, safety, model/cost guidance, and multi-shot sequence features.
- Clarified the safety contract to avoid exposing or mishandling OFOX_API_KEY.
- Expanded explanation of multi-shot ("chain") and multi-take ("batch") workflows.
- Added clear instructions for failure handling and dependency checks.
- Provides detailed command-line examples and notes on real-person moderation limits.
